about: Fault counts the gates in tool/ are held to. Read by tool/check_gates.py, which fails when a gate's count moves in either direction: up means a new fault, down means a baseline that should be lowered so the repair sticks. 'measured' is the date the count last changed. Regenerate with `python3 tool/check_gates.py --update`; write 'note' by hand.

check_comments_read_as_is.note: 40 work-item ids and history-narration phrases outside the five tom_core packages, which are at zero: 32 in tom_flutter_ui, 5 in tom_flutter_form_test, 2 in tom_flutter_ui_test and 1 in tom_core_codespecs -- see tcextension11_aidb. This gate covers what check_section_refs.py does not: quest todo ids, build-plan ids, 'Todo <n>' pointers and past-indicative narration about the code's own history.

check_doc_dart_blocks.note: Lands at zero because the 14 faults it was written for were repaired in the same pass, across 11 tom_core_kernel documents. Zero here does not mean the tree is clean: only tom_core_kernel is in PACKAGES, and doc/api_reference/ is excluded within it. tom_core_server reports 19 when run with its name as an argument, tom_flutter_ui and tom_core_flutter have not been surveyed -- see tcextension7_aico-doc-dart-blocks-other-packages.

check_doc_error_keys.note: One key listed in an "Error keys" section that no code raises: `storage.blob.exists` in tom_core_server_file_storage_new.md.

check_doc_inventories.note: Zero because all 94 faults were repaired by `--fix` in one pass. The repair was forced: the repo-wide `dart format` of tcincb1_ahti reflowed 777 Dart files, and an INDEX/HEADER/LINES claim is measured against the module's source line totals, not against the wording of the document -- so the reflow invalidated 46 figures on top of the 48 already stale here. `--fix` cannot repair only the 46: a figure is right or wrong, so the same pass also discharged the 48 that tcfinal1_aicl_stale_module_header_figures owned. 33 documents, 90 substitutions, every line identical in length before and after, so no line needed re-wrapping. Adding or retiring a table row still needs a hand, because a new row needs a sentence saying what the file carries.

check_doc_samples.note: 8 miscalled constructors in two tom_flutter_ui documents -- five TomForm* samples passing a named argument to a constructor whose first parameter is positional, and three TomColumn samples passing positionally to a named-only constructor.

check_doc_tocs.note: 39 sections no table of contents lists, 2 entries linking to no heading, and 1 contents list in an order its document does not follow, across 9 documents.

check_section_refs.note: 101 bare section references in shipped lib/, test/ and example/ code -- '§7.2', 'tests §27', 'Phase 2a §16' -- indexing quest plans that ship with neither the package nor its tests, so a reader of the shipped artefact cannot resolve them. The five tom_core packages are now at zero; what remains is 43 in tom_flutter_ui, 32 in tom_flutter_form_test, 16 in tom_flutter_ui_test and 5 in tom_core_codespecs -- see tcextension11_aidb.

check_tooling_table.note: Lands at zero because the two faults it was written for were repaired in the same pass: check_unimplemented_claims.py and this gate itself were on disk with no row in the README tooling table and no prose section. Zero is the expected steady state -- the gate exists for recurrence, not backlog. The drift it guards had already re-opened once: check_kernel_bridge.py and check_section_numbers.py were filed as missing, were added incidentally before the filing was worked, and a third script had silently taken their place by then.

check_unimplemented_claims.note: Lands at zero because the nine faults it was written for were repaired in the same pass: two copies of one `Implemented: No` table, in tom_ui_flutter_widgets.md and tom_ui_widgets_forms.md, each denying nine widgets that had shipped months earlier.
